description_en: Queries a list of user groups on a bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的用户组列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-user-groups --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserGroups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462953.htmloperation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询用户组列表的堡垒机实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query user groups.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462924.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询用户组列表的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the user group that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的用户组名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: user_group_name

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of user groups returned

Comment.description_en: The description of the user group

MemberCount.description_en: The number of users in the user group

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the user group

UserGroupName.description_en: The name of the user group
